lines.text: Billionaire weddings make headlines. Here's what a luxury one really costs.
A private estate. Walls of flowers. Dinner for a hundred fifty guests.
The venue alone: fifty thousand dollars.
Dinner and an open bar: fifty-two thousand five hundred.
A planner to run it all: fifteen thousand.
Add photos, music, the dress and the rest: two hundred thousand. Over thirteen hundred per guest.
The average American wedding? Two hundred ninety-two per guest. Would you go big, or elope?
